usage: The word '大腿' refers to the upper part of the leg between the hip and the knee.
'大腿' is a noun and can be used to talk about muscles, injuries, and exercises related to this part of the body.
You can use '大腿' with verbs like '疼' (ting4 - to ache) or '拉傷' (laai1 soeng1 - to strain).
It's common to mention '大腿' when describing fitness routines, such as squats or leg raises.
'大腿' can also be used in comparison sentences to describe size or strength.
